authority_and_budget: Original cycle005 allocation remains unchanged. No new spending, model-access assumption, statistical alpha or holdout reset.

additional_requirements.objective_preserving_reframe: Represent immutable useful objective and hard obligations separately from implementation assumptions. An executable reframe may remove an inherited design dependency only while preserving source identity, required behavior, service and safety checks. Changed objective or evaluator is a new experiment, never retroactive success.
additional_requirements.enabling_construction: An unresolved or unsupported defect may generate a typed missing-capability specification with evidence, measurable acceptance and limits. An instrument specification alone is not an implemented enabling capability. Test any actual construction against the same useful objective and the strongest complete available alternative.
additional_requirements.policy_tool_cross: Cross old/new discovery or search policy with old/new starting capability sets under matched task access, candidate bounds and unchanged external evaluation. Report all four cells and independent conventional controls, including ties, failures and unrepresentable cells. A new toolbox does not establish improved policy; a developer-authored policy replacement is not acquired learning.
additional_requirements.retained_complementary_bundle: Acquire contributions through actual evidence-bound development, store/load them with applicability and exact source checks, and generate a fresh bundle through the public retained pipeline. Evaluate empty, A-only, B-only and A+B arms under one unchanged final useful objective. The evaluator cannot hand-author combined operators or add omitted repair rules. Disclose scoped component verification and any boundary assumptions; individual failure of the full task cannot be hidden by a verified-in-scope label.
